803035.rationale: New York is the first to be waiting on a legislated statewide data-centre moratorium (A11560/S10642, passed 4 June 2026). Hochul has until 31 Dec to act and is widely expected to sign. Maine's similar bill was vetoed on 24 April 2026, and other states have only introduced bills.

24813.rationale: Stage 11 Vichy-Nevers is flat and suits the sprinters, though it comes the day after a mountain stage. The main candidates are Philipsen, Merlier (both won Belgium Tour stages), Girmay (Belgium Tour opener), Pedersen and Meeus (top-ranked sprinter on PCS). Milan is skipping the Tour.

329053.rationale: In May-June 2026 rankings, Nvidia is at about $5.0-5.4T, Alphabet at about $4.4-4.7T and Apple at about $4.3-4.6T. A gap that large is unlikely to close in three weeks.

32938.rationale: The 36-hole leader is not the winner, and sportsbooks price Scheffler at +400 to +550 and McIlroy at +650. Fleetwood (local to Birkdale), Schauffele and Rahm come next.

425213.rationale: Under the October 2025 'ceasefire', Gaza City and Khan Younis/al-Mawasi see the most multi-fatality strikes (family homes, tents for displaced people, police posts). Nuseirat, Bureij and Deir al-Balah are regularly hit too.

126882.rationale: OPCW's May 2026 deployment in Syria found dozens of undeclared aerial bombs of the Ltamenah/Khan Shaykhun type and Ghouta-type rockets. These are now being readied for verified on-site destruction, and an aerial-bomb or rocket munition is the likeliest first item destroyed.

683823.rationale: Swiss rules (and the July 2025 precedent) have Beznau shuts down both river-cooled units when the Aare stays above 25C for three days, which cuts Switzerland's whole fleet; in 2026 Beznau has no cooling tower and had already halved output on 23 June. The next closest cases are single sites in Slovakia (Bohunice), Hungary (Paks), Romania (Cernavoda) and Spain (Asco).

723378.rationale: Parker's managers keep saying 'contamination', and UKAD usually exonerates athletes by finding contaminated food, supplements or a drink. Parker himself has speculated about a cup of tea.

687277.rationale: Federal payrolls are down about 350K from the October 2024 peak and fall fastest in July. Financial activities lost 22K in May (insurance and finance), and AI-driven cuts are also weighing on professional and business services and on information (media and broadcasting).

772343.rationale: If the Aare stays hot, Beznau would shut down Switzerland's whole fleet (Goesgen and Leibstadt have cooling towers). Slovakia, Hungary and Romania have river-cooled single sites that occasionally shut down completely.
